scope: Single player implementation; game state and local scenario presentation
retained: player/NPC battle, action tick, statuses, HP/MP
experience, rewards, items and companion state
excluded: outgoing player chat/whisper UI and remote recipient routing

conditional.file_transfer_60_69: unneeded when every required resource is provided locally; retain its precondition checks if using original client
conditional.incoming_chat_or_names: may carry NPC/system text; not globally discarded
conditional.account_server_login: may be replaced by local profile loading in Unity; preserve if retaining original executable handshake

field_policy: Opaque or generic fields are retained when their single-player dependency cannot be disproven; no multiplayer exclusion by guesswork
persistence: Original server database/progress storage cannot be inferred from client display setters; a Unity local save format is a separate implementation choice
